title: Align central control-plane transport documentation with A1 attestation and request MACs
outcome: The central control-plane brief accurately describes A1's attested control stream and authenticated requests, with the runtime pair key never transmitted.
acceptance: The L1 transport section of docs/features/central-control-plane.md describes mutual control-stream attestation, HKDF-derived request keys, per-request MAC and counter window, and states that the runtime pair key is never transmitted.
The obsolete transmitted-capability and signing-as-a-later-slice statements are removed or updated, with a cross-reference to docs/features/federation-link.md; the edit changes documentation only.
